# Under the Jaw

*At the Wardens' table, the First Warden gives her charge: at the lowest spring tide, go under the Jaw.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 4 Elite Disturbance-touched bulls ([Grey Bull](../monsters/grey_bull.md)) in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)
- Defeat 1 Epic Deeply touched golem ([Wrackgolem](../monsters/wrackgolem.md)) in [The Skerries](../maps/skerries.md)
- Bring 5 [Skerries Shell](../items/skerries_sign.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 68,000 EXP
- 2,600 mesos
- +50 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Iska](../npcs/first_warden_iska.md)
- Unlocks `boss.undertow`
